# Jump3r 1.0.5

Unmodified LGPL 2.1+ Java port of LAME, used through its engine API without Java Sound or native code.

- Project: https://git.iem.at/sciss/jump3r
- Sources: https://repo.maven.apache.org/maven2/de/sciss/jump3r/1.0.5/jump3r-1.0.5-sources.jar
- Artifact: de.sciss:jump3r:1.0.5
- Replace the dependency in core/build.gradle.kts and rebuild with Gradle to relink a modified version. Signing is user-controlled.
- License: COPYING; also displayed in the app under 开源许可.
